content.short: Metera is a sustainability-focused DeFi protocol on Cardano for impact-driven investment portfolios.
content.description: Metera is a decentralized finance protocol on Cardano focused on mindful investing through sustainability-driven portfolios. Users can access tokenized portfolios known as Metera Tokenized Portfolios, which are designed around assets vetted for social and environmental impact. The protocol uses impact measurement to reduce greenwashing risk and align portfolio exposure with real-world sustainability goals. Governed by a DAO, Metera gives the Cardano community a way to support diversified, impact-oriented DeFi products.
